_comment: Performance baseline for SorobanPay SubscriptionProtocol — Benchmark branch.
_comment2: Update via: npm run update-baseline (from project root, requires live testnet access).
_comment3: CI budget check: fails if any metric exceeds baseline * 1.25 (+25%).
_comment4: Values are representative estimates derived from simulateTransaction analysis.
_comment5: Run `bash scripts/benchmark.sh` on testnet to obtain live measurements.

subscribe._comment: Pure write: 1 require_auth + 6 validations + allowance cross-contract call + 1 persistent write + 1 index write + 1 roster write + 1 TTL extend + 1 event publish.

execute_payment._comment: Highest cost: 1 require_auth + 1 storage read + 2 cross-contract calls (allowance + balance + transfer) + 1 storage write + 1 TTL extend + 1 execution marker write + 1 event publish.

cancel._comment: Lowest cost: 1 require_auth + 1 storage has + 1 storage remove + 1 index remove + 1 roster remove + 1 event publish.

update_subscription._comment: In-place update: 1 require_auth + 1 storage read + 4 validations + 1 storage write + 1 TTL extend + 1 event publish. No cross-contract calls.

pause_subscription._comment: Pause: 1 require_auth + 1 storage read + 1 optional timestamp check + 1 storage write + 1 TTL extend + 1 event publish.

resume_subscription._comment: Resume: 1 require_auth + 1 storage read + 1 timestamp read + next_payment recompute + 1 storage write + 1 TTL extend + 1 event publish.

batch_execute_payment._comment: Batch (10 subscribers): 1 require_auth + 10 × (storage read + allowance + balance + transfer + storage write + TTL extend + 2 events). Cost scales linearly with batch size.

transfer_subscription._comment: Transfer: 2 require_auth (subscriber + old_merchant) + 1 storage read + 1 storage write (new key) + 1 storage remove (old key) + 2 index updates + 2 roster updates + 1 TTL extend + 1 event publish.
